cardiac_apex.name: Cardiac apex (left ventricular wall point farthest from the mitral valve centre)

left_ventricle_centroid.name: Left ventricle cavity centroid (centre of the blood pool)
left_ventricle_centroid.derived: volume centroid of the closed Rodero left-ventricular cavity (blood pool) surface (asset cache rodero/work/parts/cav_lv.obj), mapped into the body frame by the registration (tools/organs/registration.json rodero_heart.transform): the baked chamber wall is open at the valve rings, so it has no volume centroid of its own
